documents.title: Notice Of EGM To Be Held On Wednesday, 2Nd December, 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Shree Pushkar Chemicals & Fertilisers Limited reported a strong financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by higher revenues and profitability across its chemical and fertilizer segments, improved market realizations, and sustained demand. Management highlighted the commencement of commercial production at Unit 5 and the 10 MW solar project, alongside ongoing capacity expansion initiatives such as the new chemical plant at Unit 5 and the subsidiary expansion at Madhya Bharat Phosphates. While noting that fertilizer performance in Q3 may be somewhat subdued due to seasonal factors and weather conditions, management maintained an optimistic full-year outlook for overall sales and earnings. Shree Pushkar Chemicals & Fertilisers Limited reported Revenue from Operations of Rs. 403.5 Cr in Q2 FY27, registering a 58.2% YoY growth driven by demand across its chemical and fertiliser segments.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve total sales of at least INR1,250 crores for the annual performance of FY27.
guidance.quote: In my opinion, if you ask me, we should be able to achieve at least INR1,250 crores of total sales and profitability should be in three digits.

guidance.claim: Management indicated that turnover for next year could reach close to INR2,000 crores with a possible 10% variation.
guidance.quote: Sir, if I talk about next year, like 2027-2028, in my opinion, we should be somewhere closer to near around INR2,000 crores.

guidance.claim: The new chemical plant project at Ratnagiri Unit 5 is targeted for commissioning by March 2028.
guidance.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned by March 2028 and is aimed at catering to the growing demand from customers.

guidance.claim: Management stated revenue visibility could move towards Rs. 1,350 crores to Rs. 1,400 crores in FY27.
guidance.quote: I wouldn't be surprised if that figure moves toward Rs. 1,350 crores or Rs. 1,400 crores.

guidance.claim: Management sees the possibility of revenue crossing Rs. 1,700 to Rs. 1,750 crores next year with a full 12 months of operations from Unit 6.
guidance.quote: So with a full 12 months, I see the possibility of crossing 1,700 to 1,750.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the chemical business margins have improved due to strong demand and supply shortages in China resulting from environmental and safety norms compliance.
demand_outlook.quote: First of all, as far as the chemical space is concerned, the margins have improved mainly because of the China factor. In China, there is a huge shortage going on in terms of dye intermediates, mainly because of various compliances in terms of environment and safety norms in China.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Q3 may remain a bit subdued for the fertilizer segment due to a poor season.
demand_outlook.quote: And going forward, I see that quarter three, mainly because of a poor season in terms of fertilizers, it may remain a bit subdued.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that global demand is still a bit weak.
demand_outlook.quote: Although we have started the plant, but overall, if you see, global demand is still a bit weak.

demand_outlook.claim: Q2 FY27 revenue growth of 58.2% YoY was driven by sustained demand across the chemical and fertiliser segments.
demand_outlook.quote: During the quarter, Revenue from Operations stood at Rs. 403.5 Cr, registering a robust growth of 58.2% YoY, supported by sustained demand and improved business performance across the Company's Chemical and Fertiliser segments.

demand_outlook.claim: In Q1 FY27, fertilizer sales volume was 66,527 metric tons and chemical sales volume was 9,113 metric tons.
demand_outlook.quote: The fertilizer business recorded the sales volume of 66,527 metric tons compared to 76,288 metric tons in Q1 FY26, while volumes in the chemical business were 9,113 metric tons compared to 14,837 metric tons in the corresponding period.

demand_outlook.claim: Improved realizations across both segments helped offset lower sales volumes.
demand_outlook.quote: However, improved realization across both the businesses helped offset the impact of lower volume and supported growth in the sales value.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is becoming more apparent in Q2 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: In Q2, the demand is becoming even more apparent.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has received plenty of inquiries for K-acid, H-acid, and Vinyl Sulphone from China.
demand_outlook.quote: We have plenty of inquiries for K-acid, H-acid, and Vinyl Sulphone to China.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production at Unit 5 commenced during the quarter, strengthening dye manufacturing capacity by approximately 6,000 metric tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Moving to our operational developments, we are pleased to share that commercial production at Unit 5 of our company commenced during this quarter, strengthening our dye manufacturing capacity by approximately 6,000 metric tons per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved a capital expenditure of INR70 crores to establish a new chemical plant at Unit 5, Lote Parshuram, with an additional capacity of 3,000 metric tons per annum, expected to be commissioned by March 2028.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with our growth strategy, the board has also approved a capital expenditure of INR70 crores for establishing a new chemical plant at Unit 5, Lote Parshuram, with an additional capacity of 3,000 metric tons per annum. The project is expected to be commissioned by March 2028 and is aimed at catering to the growing demand of our customers.

capex_expansion.claim: As of September 30, the company has invested INR92 crores in ongoing capex projects, completely funded through internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: As on date, as on 30th of September, the Company has invested INR92 crores in the ongoing capex project, which has been totally funded by the internal accruals of the company.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has a strategic growth plan at Meghnagar Unit 8 to add 3,00,000 MTPA capacity for complex fertilisers.
Ongoing expansion projects at Ratnagiri and Meghnagar are expected to add 4,50,000 MT per annum of fertilizer capacity and 72,000 MT per annum of chemical capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Together, these projects are expected to add 4,50,000 metric tons per annum of fertilizer capacity and 72,000 metric tons per annum of the chemical capacity additionally, significantly expanding the company's manufacturing base.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired around 30,000 square meters of land at Lote Parshuram for Rs. 9.33 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, the company acquired approximately 30,000 square meters of additional land at Lote Parshuram for Rs. 9.33 crores, located near the existing Unit 1.

capex_expansion.claim: The 10 megawatt DC solar power project at Nanded will bring total installed solar capacity to 20.6 megawatt DC.
capex_expansion.quote: The 10 megawatt DC solar power project at Nanded is nearing completion and once commissioned, we will take the company's total installed solar capacity to 20.6 megawatt on DC basis.

capex_expansion.claim: Cumulative capex incurred stood at Rs. 209 crores as of June 30, 2026, against total planned capex of Rs. 512 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: With this, cumulative capex incurred stands at Rs. 209 crores as of June 30, 2026, against the total planned capex of Rs. 512 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for Q2 FY27 increased by 96.1% year-on-year to INR35.7 crores with a PAT margin of 8.9%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax increased by 96.1% year-on-year to INR35.7 crores with a PAT margin of 8.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit for Q2 FY27 stood at INR120 crores with a gross margin of 30%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit stood at INR120 crores, registering a growth of INR42 crores year-on-year, with a gross margin of 30%.

margins_costs.claim: Shree Pushkar reported an EBITDA of Rs. 50 Cr with an EBITDA margin of ~12.0% in Q2 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: From a profitability perspective, the Company delivered EBITDA of Rs. 50 Cr with an EBITDA margin of approximately 12.0%, reflecting a growth of 88 YoY.

margins_costs.claim: Profit After Tax reached Rs. 35.7 Cr in Q2 FY27, reflecting a growth of 96.2% YoY.
margins_costs.quote: Profit After Tax (PAT) stood at Rs. 35.7 Cr, registering a significant growth of 96.2% YoY.

margins_costs.claim: Integrated operations optimize resource and raw material utilization while improving cost efficiency.
margins_costs.quote: Integrated operations optimizing resource and raw material utilization while strengthening cost efficiency across the value chain

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations grew by 10% YoY to Rs. 280.10 crores in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The revenue from the operation grew by 10% year-on-year basis to Rs. 280.10 crores during Q1 FY27.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA grew 9.7% YoY to Rs. 31.9 crores with an 11.4% margin, and PAT grew 9.4% to Rs. 22.9 crores with an 8.2% margin.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 9.7% year-on-year to Rs. 31.9 crores with a margin of 11.4%, while profit after tax grew by 9.4% to Rs. 22.9 crores with a margin of 8.2%.

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur raw material prices increased to around USD 1,100 from previous levels of USD 250-USD 300.
margins_costs.quote: Specifically, if I talk about sulphur, sulphur, which used to be in the range of USD250-USD300, in today's date, only sulphur is in the range of USD1,100.

margins_costs.claim: The company operated its acid plants on low load as a business strategy due to high input prices and working capital requirements.
margins_costs.quote: So as a business strategy, we decided to go on low load for the acid plants.

orders_capacity.claim: During Q2 FY27, the chemical business recorded sales volume of 14,368 metric tons and the fertilizer business recorded 79,277 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: In terms of sales volume, the chemical business recorded 14,368 metric tons, while the fertilizer business recorded 79,277 metric tons during the quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's total installed solar capacity on a consolidated basis increased to 20.6 megawatts on a DC basis following the commencement of the 10 MW solar project at Nanded.
orders_capacity.quote: With this addition, the company's total installed solar capacity on a consolidated basis has increased to 20.6 megawatt on a DC basis.

orders_capacity.claim: The company demonstrated operational scale with a sales volume of ~3.25 lakh MTPA across chemicals and fertilisers.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume of ~3.25 lakh MTPA across Chemicals and Fertilisers demonstrates scale and capacity utilisation

orders_capacity.claim: In Q1 FY27, the fertilizer segment recorded sales value of Rs. 142 crores while the chemical segment recorded Rs. 138 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: The fertilizer business reported sales value of Rs. 142 crores, growing by 4% on year-on-year basis, while the chemical business recorded sales value of Rs. 138 crores, registering growth of 17.10% year-on-year basis.

orders_capacity.claim: Shree Pushkar is the largest manufacturer of K-acid in India, with prices increasing from Rs. 550 to Rs. 700-plus.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, we are the largest manufacturer of K-acid in India. No one else is in K-acid. The price of the product has moved from Rs. 550 to Rs. 700-plus.

capital_allocation.claim: The board approved the issuance of 8,54,060 fully convertible warrants to Mr. Punit Gopikishan Makharia at an issue price of INR526.90 per warrant, aggregating up to INR45 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: In this regard, the board has approved the issuance of 8,54,060 fully convertible warrants to Mr. Punit Gopikishan Makharia, Promoter and Chairman and Managing Director of the company, at an issue price of INR526.90 per warrant, aggregating up to INR45 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintained a non-limited budget of INR142 crores as of September 30, 2026, from a liquidity perspective.
capital_allocation.quote: From a liquidity perspective, the company continues to maintain a comfortable financial position with a non-limited budget of INR142 crores as of 30th September 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company held Rs. 142.83 Cr in non-lien deposits as of September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Maintains Rs. 142.83 Cr in non-lien deposits as on 30th September, 2026

capital_allocation.claim: The company incurred approximately Rs. 20 crores of capex during Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Moving to our capital expenditure program, we incurred approximately Rs. 20 crores during Q1 FY27 across ongoing expansion initiatives.

capital_allocation.claim: Capex is being funded through internal accruals and proceeds from a preferential issue.
capital_allocation.quote: The balance investment will be deployed progressively as the projects advance, with the overall program being funded through the internal accruals and proceeds from the preferential issue.

capital_allocation.claim: The company held Rs. 125 crores in non-lien deposits as of June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: From a liquidity perspective, the company continues to maintain a comfortable position with Rs. 125 crores in non-lien deposits as on June 30, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Future business performance is subject to risks including Indian and global economic conditions, industry performance, competition, and market risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to,the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and world-wide, competition, the Company’s ability to successfully implement its strategy, the Company's future levels of growth and expansion, technological implementation, changes and advancements, changes in revenue, income or cashflows, the Company's market preferences and its exposure to market risks, as well as other risks.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations were impacted by ongoing global supply chain challenges and elevated raw material prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: The performance was achieved despite continued challenges around global supply chain and elevated raw material prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: The closure of the Strait of Hormuz caused acute shortages of raw materials such as ammonia and sulphur.
risks_headwinds.quote: Like ammonia is a major raw material into that, sulphur is a major raw material into that, and suddenly there was acute shortage of these two raw materials because of the closure of the Hormuz.

management_commitments.claim: The new chemical plant at Unit 5, Lote Parshuram, is expected to be commissioned by March 2028.
management_commitments.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned by March 2028 and is aimed at catering to the growing demand of our customers.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to bring in the balance money from the preferential issue before March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So probably we will be getting it before March 2027, the balance.

management_commitments.claim: The new 3,000 MTPA chemical plant project at Ratnagiri Unit 5 is planned for commissioning by March 2028.
management_commitments.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned by March 2028 and is aimed at catering to the growing demand from customers.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
